name: How much does it cost to install a gas fire pit?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to install a gas fire pit?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to install a gas fire pit varies significantly based on several factors. These include the size and materials of the fire pit, whether a new gas line needs to be run, the complexity of the design, and site preparation. Custom built-in gas fire pits with extensive hardscaping will be more expensive than simpler, pre-fabricated options. For an accurate estimate, it's best to have a contractor assess your specific project needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: The cost of gas fire pit installation depends on size, materials, gas line requirements, design complexity, and site preparation. Custom options are generally more expensive.
